title: Spain train crash: Spanish authorities identify all 69 victims

blocks.text: MADRID, Spain — Spanish authorities said on Monday they had identified all 69 people killed in last week’s high-speed train collision after confirming the identities of three more victims. Wednesday’s disaster — one of Europe’s deadliest rail accidents this century — has seen victims’ relatives endure an agonising wait as forensics teams identify the dead, sometimes from individual body parts. A legal body set up to handle the identification work, made up of police and forensics experts, announced in a statement late on Monday the three latest confirmed victims — two Australians and a Japanese citizen.
